taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-07, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-07, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-07 (Survey Area T)**

**Interpreted Layer Sequence:**
- **Layer 1:** 0.00–17.20 m, 2831.4 Ω·m
- **Layer 2:** 17.20–19.27 m, 3567.9 Ω·m
- **Layer 3:** 19.27–40.91 m, 3454.3 Ω·m
- **Layer 4:** 40.91–45.03 m, 11701.4 Ω·m
- **Layer 5:** >45.03 m, 140416.4 Ω·m (high-resistivity bedrock)

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
- Layers 1–2–3: $r_1 < r_2 > r_3 \rightarrow \text{K}$
- Layers 2–3–4: $r_2 > r_3 < r_4 \rightarrow \text{H}$
- Layers 3–4–5: $r_3 < r_4 < r_5 \rightarrow \text{A}$

The computed sequence is **KHA-type**. The file record classifying this station as **QHA-type** is inconsistent with the data because resistivity increases from Layer 1 to Layer 2, which defines a K-type rather than a Q-type initial transition.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
